title: 'I am a prisoner of conscience': Ali Karimli, the opposition figure defying Azerbaijan’s regime
summary: Azerbaijan’s opposition leader Ali Karimli, a former secretary of state, goes on trial in Baku on Wednesday for an alleged "attempted coup". Karimli spoke to FRANCE 24 from prison, where he slammed the charges against him as "entirely fabricated and politically motivated" and warned that he risked assassination.
